subject: Royle & Dorazio (2008) section 9.4 covariate models - BUGS script?

messages.author: e52aff30a33f7a8a
messages.subject: Royle & Dorazio (2008) section 9.4 covariate models - BUGS script?
parts:
Hi all,

I'm hoping to find the BUGS code for the European crossbill dynamic occupancy model with covariates (auto-logistic parameterization) described in section 9.4 of Royle & Dorazio (2008), pg. 313. I cannot find the script in the Web Supplement, as indicated in the text. And my version of the model does not give the same parameter estimates as those presented in Table 9.4 (pg 315). If anyone could provide the model script for this example, I would be grateful.

My apologies if this has been asked before (I couldn't find an answer through a quick search of the group's posts).

Thanks!
Sarah

messages.author: 527d9b3ec7deff2d
messages.subject: Re: Royle & Dorazio (2008) section 9.4 covariate models - BUGS script?
parts:
Hi Sarah,
 
I poked around with this a while ago and the code required putting the snippet from pg. 314 into the model from panel 9.2 (and adding additional priors).  I've attached a small script that can replicate Table 9.4 using the crossbill data.
